prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original square tileable forest-canopy texture for a vertically scrolling anime aircraft game.
Primary request: an unbroken dense green forest seen from nearly overhead. The entire 1024 x 1024 square is covered in continuous interlocking TREE CANOPIES. Roughly 60 to 80 small irregular broadleaf crowns of unequal size, grouped into uneven natural masses. Rich leafy treetops occupy at least 95 percent of the area; only tiny dark gaps between crowns, no open center. The view will scroll beneath an aircraft, with occasional separate landmark sprites added later.
Style: soft hand-painted anime gouache game background. Large readable rounded leafy masses, a few painterly leaf scallops and broad sunlit facets, restrained fine texture. Gentle upper-left sunlight, warm sage/olive and fresh yellow-green highlights, cool deep teal-green shadows. Medium contrast and muted highlights so projectiles remain readable. No photorealism, 3D plastic, vector outlines or noisy leaf speckles.
Composition: a flat edge-to-edge overhead treetop surface, without a horizon or perspective vanishing point. Crowns continue naturally beyond all four edges. Make opposite borders visually seamless and keep similar color/density at every border. Uneven organic spacing; no rows, grid, radial pattern, repeated identical trees, bright central focal point or central travel corridor.
Constraints: opaque full square. NO river, stream, water, lake, coast, island, raised ground platform, cliff rim, visible trunks, roads, paths, clearings, bridges, architecture, ruins, people, aircraft, clouds, fog, glow, text, UI, frames, borders or watermark. No dark void around a cluster. This is one compact reusable texture tile, not a long map or a complete landscape.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original square forest-crown variation texture for a modular anime aircraft-game map.
Input images: Image 1 is the original game's coastal art STYLE reference only. Image 2 provides the green palette and soft rounded treetop brushwork only. Do not copy the island, cliffs, water, clear ground, roads or layout from either reference.
Primary request: nearly overhead view of a connected mass of about 12 to 16 leafy broadleaf TREE CROWNS. Larger crowns nest irregularly with smaller crowns, forming a softly meandering central canopy ridge. The whole square remains filled with adjoining green foliage; tree canopies continue beyond every edge. No isolated island or exposed ground. This texture will be softly blended as small patches over another dense forest canopy, so it must be compatible in palette and camera.
Style: soft hand-painted anime gouache, broad rounded canopy silhouettes with a few gently scalloped leaf groups, matte painterly surfaces and restrained detail. Match the reference's gentle upper-left sun and cool teal-blue-green shadows. Sunlit leaf faces are soft olive/sage and yellow-green, never neon, white or glittering. No black outlines, photographic detail, plastic 3D or pixel art.
Composition: square 1024 x 1024, flat aerial treetop surface, no horizon, no strong depth, no focal object. Organic unequal crown sizes and overlaps, no grid or evenly spaced rows. Similar green color/density around all four edges so the patch can fade into matching forest foliage.
Constraints: fully opaque image with no blank margins or checkerboard. NO river, stream, water, lake, island, raised platform, cliffs, open grassy clearing, visible tree trunks, road, path, bridge, building, landmark, aircraft, characters, sky, clouds, fog, glow, text, UI, border or watermark. Do not render a sprite sheet or a long background map.
